title: feat(types,plugin-form)!: the grid's sort_field is declared, and a detail's sort field is derived only (objectui#11070 round 9)
body:
Refs #11070
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). `MasterDetailDetailConfig.sortField` retires, and `GridFieldMetadata` gains `sort_field`. It is priced in the changeset.

Round 9 of objectui#11070: the seat's answer B on `sort_field` (`5928627070`), plus `grid.mdx`'s Features prose. Claim `5929173058`; dev session `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`. DRAFT: no ready, no enqueue.

## What changes

- **(i) `sort_field` is declared** (`@object-ui/types`). `GridFieldMetadata.sort_field?: string`. Its JSDoc says what it does (the CHILD field the grid stamps with each row's index on every change, so a drag-reorder persists; not one of the columns) and who produces it (`deriveDetail` in `@object-ui/plugin-form`, through `MasterDetailForm`). `GridField` drops `UndeclaredGridKeys` and reads its config as `Partial` of `GridFieldMetadata` alone, so every key it reads is declared there (`@object-ui/fields`, comments and one type annotation; no runtime change).
- **(ii) The authored override retires** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`). `MasterDetailDetailConfig` has no `sortField` member. The derived value travels on the form's internal per-detail record (`DetailEntry.sortField`, beside the existing internal `amountFieldDef`), set only from `derived.sortField`, and the grid config reads `sort_field: entry.sortField`. The `d.sortField ?? derived.sortField` bridge is gone from both derive branches. The amount override (`amountField`) is untouched.
  - Why `DetailEntry` and not a second config type: the authored object is spread into the resolved config (`{ ...d, … }`), and a fully configured detail keeps it as is. A resolved-config type that carried `sortField` would therefore still carry a stray authored `sortField` at runtime on that path, which is the dual read this round removes. On `DetailEntry` the field has one writer, the derivation.
- **(iii) `grid.mdx`.** The typed fence writes `sort_field: 'position'`, and the field-level key list documents it the way round 8 documented `total_field` and `add_label`. The Features list was audited bullet by bullet against `GridField` (below).
- **Pins.** The 11144 row "an authored sort field wins over the derived one" retires with the member; its three derived-`position` / amount rows stay green. The 8071 members pin is re-counted and re-pointed: header prose (eleven members, four renamed on the way, `sort_field` derived), row 2 with `sortField` moved to the off-list set (not read), a new row 2c (derived pick vs a written `sortField`, with a lit control), and a compile-time block (an exact `keyof MasterDetailDetailConfig` list, a `@ts-expect-error` refusal of `sortField`, and a lit control). `GridField.fieldKeys-11070` gains a `sort_field` drag-reorder row and its no-key control, and its `declared` fixture writes `sort_field`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/11070-grid-sort-field-round9.md`: `@object-ui/types` minor (one new optional member, a feature), `@object-ui/plugin-form` minor (a published member retires: breaking, priced minor under the fixed group's policy, stated), `@object-ui/fields` patch (no runtime change). Dated, append-only notes on the two pending changesets this round makes false: `11070-grid-field-keys-round8` ("`sort_field` … stays read and undeclared") and `11144-inline-columns-sort-amount` ("or a detail's own `amountField` / `sortField` still wins").

## The `sortField` census (measured first)

objectui base `1a88ce22` (exact-word `git grep -w`), objectstack `origin/main` `e952cff5` (same query; control `amountField` hits 12 files there).

| Site | Role | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deriveDetail` (`plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`) | writer (derived) | the child's first `position` / `sort_order` / `sequence` / `line_no` / `line_number` / `sort` field | unchanged: the one producer |
| Authored documents, example apps, catalog fixtures, docs (objectui) | writer | 0 | 0 |
| objectstack: spec, examples, docs, `os migrate meta` conversions | writer | 0 (`sortField` and `sort_field` both) | 0 |
| `attachInlineSubforms` (app-shell) | writer of `subforms[]` | writes `childObject` / `relationshipField` / `inlineMode` / `title` / `columns` / `amountField`; no `sortField` | unchanged |
| Drawer / Modal `subforms` types | declared shape | no `sortField` member | unchanged |
| `object-master-detail-form` registration `inputs` (`plugin-form/src/index.tsx`) | declared shape | `details`: array, no members | unchanged |
| 11144 pin, row "an authored sort field wins" | test writer | `sortField: 'line_no'` | row retired |
| 8071 pin, row 2 | test writer | `sortField: 'position'` as a member | an off-list key, asserted not read |
| `MasterDetailDetailConfig.sortField` | declared member | declared | retired (compile error) |
| `MasterDetailForm` resolve effect, both derive branches | reader | `d.sortField ?? derived.sortField` | `derived.sortField`, on `DetailEntry` |
| `MasterDetailForm` grid config | reader | `sort_field: d.sortField` | `sort_field: entry.sortField` |
| `MasterDetailForm`, fully configured detail (no derive) | reader | the authored `sortField` only | none (nothing is derived there, before or after) |
| `GridField` `cfg.sort_field` | reader | through `UndeclaredGridKeys` | declared `GridFieldMetadata.sort_field` |

objectui#11144's thread names no user of the authored override: the issue body says `attachInlineSubforms` carries only `inlineColumns` and `inlineAmountField`, and the claim's "an authored `amountField` (`inlineAmountField`) or `sortField` still wins" states a symmetry, not a writer.

## `grid.mdx` Features audit

| Bullet | Against `GridField` | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| Table Display: clean tabular layout | true | kept, with "every row shown" |
| Pagination Preview: first 5 rows, "Showing X of Y" | false: every row renders (`rows.map` in both the read-only and editable bodies), and no "Showing" text exists in the widget | removed |
| Type-Specific Rendering: each column renders according to its type | true for editable cells; in read-only mode only `date` / `datetime` / `time`, `file` and `lookup` cells are formatted (probe below) | corrected to say exactly that |
| Read-Only Mode: full table view without editing | true | kept |
| Responsive: scrollable for many columns | true (`overflow-x-auto`, per-type minimum widths) | kept |

## Ablations (predictions written before each run; every mutation through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit as declared, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty)

- **A1, an undeclared `sort_field` read** (the member deleted from `GridFieldMetadata`, types rebuilt; dist marker 1 to 0). Predicted and observed: fields `tsc --noEmit` TS2339 on `cfg.sort_field`; fields `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` TS2353 on the `declared` fixture and on `grid({ sort_field })`; `check:doc-snippets` 1 failed block, `grid.mdx` TS2353 `sort_field`. Restore leg: types rebuilt, dist marker back to 1, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **A2, an authored `sortField` type-checking again** (`sortField?: string;` planted back on `MasterDetailDetailConfig`). Predicted and observed: plugin-form `tsc --noEmit` green; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exactly 2 errors in the 8071 file, TS2322 on the member list and TS2578 on the now-unused `@ts-expect-error`.
- **A3, the `??` bridge restored** (both `sortField: derived.sortField,` sites to `(d as any).sortField ?? derived.sortField`). Predicted and observed over the three touched test files: 1 failed, 24 passed; the failure is row 2c, `expected 'line_no' to be 'position'`.
- **A4, the false Features bullet restored** in `grid.mdx` (the "Showing X of Y" pagination claim). Predicted and observed: `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links`, `check:doc-types` and `check:doc-example-ids` all green. No gate can see a prose bullet; this round's correction is held by review only.

## Local verification (final head `2c59d3b5`, the merge of `origin/main` `c82ff391` on top of `5376e31a`)

The type-checker set is these three: `MasterDetailDetailConfig` is referenced only inside plugin-form (a comment in an `apps/console` test names it), and `GridFieldMetadata` gains one optional member, which no consumer can break.
- vitest (`--maxWorkers=2`, through the lock): `packages/plugin-form/` 159 files, 1836 passed and 1 skipped; `packages/types/` plus every `GridField*` / `LineItems*` test, 325 files and 8103 tests passed.

Invariance: no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Hypotheses

- H1 holds: 0 authored writers in either repository; the writers are `deriveDetail` and two test fixtures.
- H2 holds: a type split was enough, with no renderer change, for every child that has a sort-named field and is derived. A fully configured detail derives nothing, before and after; that is objectui#11144's own carrier note, not a change here.
- H3 holds: M3 does not move.

## Stop condition reached: the `object-master-detail-form.details` parity row (excluded file, PR #11335)

`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` is not touched. Its `MEMBER_PINS['object-master-detail-form.details']` row stays mechanically green (the locator needs only the pin file to exist and to name the block and the key). Its `pins` prose, though, is now false in two places: "five members reach the grid through ONE hand-written object and four are RENAMED on the way (`sortField` to `sort_field`, …)" and "names five of the twelve members the renderer reads". The brief says to stop and report before that row changes, so the row is reported, not edited, and the dev report puts it to the seat with options.

## Acceptance notes (not this round's scope)

- Read-only `GridField` formats only `date` / `datetime` / `time`, `file` and `lookup` cells. A scratch probe (uncommitted, removed) rendered one row `{ amount: 1234.5, status: 'paid', qty: 1234.5 }` with `currency`, `select` (option label `Paid`) and `number` columns: read-only cells read `1234.5`, `paid`, `1234.5`; the same row in list mode reads `1,234.5`, `Paid`, `1,234.5`. No reach was measured (the docs page's read-only example writes values that read the same either way), so it is noted here and not filed.
- `grid.mdx`'s "Integration with Advanced Grid" list (outside the Features list) offers add/remove rows, drag-and-drop reordering and formula columns as plugin features, which the basic grid also has. Left as is.
- `docs/adr/0001-master-detail-subform.md` (governed) names `sort_field` and `row[sortField] = index`. An ADR records the decision taken; left as is.

## Patch (answer A) — added by the seat

- Seat answer A (`5929940616` on objectui#11070) to this PR's open question. After PR #11335 landed, `origin/main` `20d23bef` was merged in as `36313b7f`; the merge touches none of this PR's files.
- `09d3ebf0` edits exactly the two clauses of the `object-master-detail-form.details` row's `pins` prose in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: "four members … each RENAMED … beside `columns` and the DERIVED `sort_field`", and "five of the eleven members".
- The same commit moves the 8071 pin's fully configured `sortField` check from row 2 into row 2c, so row 2 keeps exactly the two off-list members that the parity row describes.
- The follow-up dev report is `5930257276`. The dev's contract forbids a dev PATCH of this body, so the seat wrote this section.
